Done. All changes are QA artifacts (probe outputs + token file) — no source code touched, so no commit per the charter ("if it works, leave it alone").

## Summary — Run 50, backend API re-verification

**Verdict: Backend converged — 10th consecutive run with 0 code fixes. 0 unintentional 5xx.**

I minted an admin JWT DB-direct (server on **:3001**, not :3000) and ran the full standing probe suite against `feat/financing`:

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| `.qa-sweep-all` (245 routes) | 200×91 / 400×72 / 403×6 / 404×75 / 503×1 — **0 unintentional 5xx** |
| `.qa-type-fuzz` (1026 payloads) | 0 5xx / 0 err |
| tenant-isolation | 22/22 (tenant_id query/body + X-Tenant-Id spoof all ignored; non-platform-admin → 403) |
| happy-write | 3/3 (PATCH lead `{priority:warm}`→200, PATCH invoice `{status:sent}`→200) |
| gaps / uncovered / typefuzz-2 / pagination | all clean, correct 400/404/200 codes |

Every non-200 is **intentional**: skip-trace 503 (no `TRACERFY_API_KEY`, by the zero-paid-API constraint), Stripe webhook 400 (no signature header), 6×403 admin-only routes, auth 429 (login rate limiter).

**Two harness-only issues** (test scripts, not server code — left as-is):
- `.qa-deep-probe.mjs` crashes with `ERR_UNESCAPED_CHARACTERS` — it builds a Node request path with unescaped chars. Pre-existing probe defect, zero server impact.
- Token-path gotcha cost one iteration: `.qa-sweep-all` reads repo-root `.qa-token.txt` while the others read `/tmp/qa-token.txt` (=`C:\tmp`). After `node .qa-mint-token.mjs` you must also `cp /c/tmp/qa-token.txt .qa-token.txt`, or sweep-all reports phantom mass-401s. Documented in both the deliverable and resume.

**Deliverable:** `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt`. **Resume updated** with the Run 50 entry.

The backend has now returned zero fixes for 10 straight runs. The genuinely high-value untouched gaps are all **frontend**: keyboard nav (Esc-to-close missing app-wide) and finishing the tablet-768px sweep (Invoices, Reports, Estimates, LeadDetail, Subcontractors, Expenses, Contracts, Settings tabs).
